origine_fr: Le cœur 忄 et 卓, qui donnait le son mais se lit zhuó, loin de dào. Au départ, 悼 veut dire « craindre ». Aujourd'hui, c'est pleurer un mort.
origine_en: The heart 忄 and 卓, which gave the sound but is read zhuó, far from dào. At first, 悼 means “to fear”. Today it means to mourn the dead.

mots.en: to mourn, to pay tribute to

phrase.pinyin: Rénmen lái dào zhèli dàoniàn tā.
phrase.fr: Les gens viennent ici honorer sa mémoire.
phrase.en: People come here to mourn him.
